title: Determine publication recovery disposition
description: Relate a failed or uncertain attempt to authoritative external state and a supported authorized recovery action while preserving public history and failure evidence. It distinguishes recovery decisions from an automatic retry.
inputs: Attempt identity, failure phase, known external effects, and retained candidate/evidence.
Available authoritative registry/tag/asset state and applicable owner recovery or deferral decisions.
outputs: Before/during-uncertain/after-publication disposition and required further inspection.
Supported authorized correction or retry basis, retained failed evidence, and open follow-up.
behavior: Establish what is known about external effects before choosing any retry or correction.
Distinguish no successful write from uncertain and failed-after-publication outcomes.
Preserve published versions and original evidence; select only applicable fix-forward, channel correction, deprecation, or explicit follow-up within authority.
Retain complete exceptional-deferral ownership/risk/limits and nondeferable duties until disposition.
Do not turn lost reporting, unavailable public evidence, or duplicate events into authority to republish.

failure_behavior.condition: Authoritative external state is unavailable after an uncertain write.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the attempt uncertain and withhold blind retry.

failure_behavior.condition: A proposed recovery would overwrite a published version or erase evidence.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject that action and identify the supported correction boundary.

failure_behavior.condition: Required recovery authority or exception basis is missing.
failure_behavior.outcome: Record the precise unresolved decision and preserve failed/open status.
